title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.29206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our results reveal a detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely miss benevolent bias, while LLM judges catch more under more explicit detection criteria but increasingly misclassify neutral support as benevolent bias, and demographic contex

translated_title: 多轮人机对话中的善意偏见
translated_abstract: 人机交互中的偏见不仅可以表现为敌对语言，还可以表现为“善意偏见”（benevolent bias），即不平等的对待隐藏在温暖、积极的语气背后。为了使其可被检测，我们从语气与对待方式两个维度对善意偏见进行操作化定义，从而得到三类：中性支持、显性偏见和善意偏见。基于这些定义，我们构建了 BENEVDIAL——一个类别平衡的语料库，包含 362,880 段多轮支持性对话，涵盖用户与代理的人口统计特征、角色和生成器，以支持受控评估。随后我们在其上测试了两类检测器：现成的安全检测器和经提示的大语言模型（LLM）评判者。我们的结果揭示了一个检测差距：现成的检测器能够可靠地标记显性偏见，却在很大程度上漏检善意偏见；而 LLM 评判者在更明确的检测标准下能捕获更多偏见，但越来越多地将中性支持误判为善意偏见，且人口统计背景……
tldr: 该论文首次将“善意偏见”操作化为语气与对待方式两个维度，构建了包含36万余段多轮对话的类别平衡语料库BENEVDIAL，并揭示了现成安全检测器能识别显性偏见却漏检善意偏见、而LLM评判者虽捕获更多却将中性支持误判为偏见的检测差距。
en_tdlr: The paper operationalizes benevolent bias along tone and treatment dimensions, builds BENEVDIAL—a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues—and reveals a detection gap where off-the-shelf safety detectors reliably flag overt bias but miss benevolent bias, while LLM judges catch more yet increasingly misclassify neutral support as biased.
